notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Problems EmailBridge detected in your organisation, newest first. Resolved items stay here for 90 days.
notifications.empty_body: No open problems. New ones show up here the moment they are detected.
notifications.bulk_resolve_hint: Only info items can be resolved in bulk. Resolve warnings and critical problems from their detail.

prefs.title: Notifications
prefs.org_disabled: Alert emails are turned off for this organisation. An owner or admin can turn them on in Settings, Switches. The bell keeps working.
prefs.email_hint: Critical problems arrive at once; the rest follow your digest.
prefs.email_role_hint: Off by default for viewers and operators. Turn on to receive alert emails.
prefs.quiet_hint: Non-critical emails wait for the next digest during these hours.

failing.title: Webhook {name} is failing
failing.detail: {failures} deliveries in a row failed. Check the endpoint and its recent deliveries.

deadletter.title: Webhook {name} is dead-lettering events
deadletter.detail: {count} deliveries were dead-lettered in the last hour.

auth.title: Mailbox {name} cannot sign in
auth.detail: The mail server rejected the credentials. Update them to resume sync.

connect.title: Mailbox {name} cannot connect
connect.detail: The mail server is unreachable or refused the connection.

disabled.title: Mailbox {name} is disabled
disabled.detail: Sync is paused until the account is enabled again.

syncStall.title: Mailbox {name} stopped syncing
syncStall.detail: No successful sync for longer than the configured limit.

cert.title: Certificate for {name} expires soon
cert.detail: Renew the client certificate before it expires to keep the mailbox connected.

pending.title: Queue {queue} is backing up
pending.detail: {pending} messages are waiting and nothing has been acknowledged recently.

oldest.title: Queue {queue} has stale messages
oldest.detail: The oldest message has waited longer than the configured limit.

paused.title: Queue {queue} has been paused for a while
paused.detail: Work is piling up while the queue stays paused.

failures.title: Sending failures are rising
failures.detail: {rate}% of an account's messages failed or bounced in the last hour.

node.title: Node {node} is missing
node.detail: The node stopped reporting without draining first.

migrations.title: Database migrations are pending
migrations.detail: Run the pending migrations to finish the upgrade.

apikey.title: API key {name} expires soon
apikey.detail: Rotate the key before it expires so integrations keep working.

failing.title: Integration {name} is failing
failing.detail: The last {connector} action failed. Open the integration to see the error.

internal.title: Internal error in {component}
internal.detail: EmailBridge hit an unexpected error in {component} ({code}). It is grouped here and reported.
